included_sources.title: SAQ: Pushing the Limits of Vector Quantization through Code Adjustment and Dimension Segmentation
included_sources.reviewed_evidence: Sections 3 and 5, especially the O(rD) code-adjustment analysis and Table 4 quantization-time boundary
included_sources.supports: The SAQ scientific efficiency claim concerns vector quantization/construction work under an explicitly stated inclusion boundary; it does not treat research-review JSON serialization as quantization time.
included_sources.does_not_support: It does not define an exact arbitrary-cardinality training protocol or justify a V2 cost threshold.

included_sources.title: Optimal Quantization by Matrix Searching
included_sources.reviewed_evidence: Abstract and algorithmic complexity statement for histogram-weighted MSE quantization
included_sources.supports: Matrix searching reduces the classical discrete optimal K-level quantization DP from O(KN^2) to O(KN) in its arithmetic model; the algorithmic result is an optimum quantizer, not a canonical trace of every internal state.
included_sources.does_not_support: The O(KN) statement is not an arbitrary-precision rational bit-complexity or wall-time guarantee and does not include A4 evidence serialization.

included_sources.title: Fast Exact k-Means, k-Medians and Bregman Divergence Clustering in 1D
included_sources.reviewed_evidence: Sections 2-4, including recurrence, leftmost tie rule, complete totally monotone matrix, weighted extension, O(kn) time, and O(n) reporting space
included_sources.supports: An exact optimum curve and partition can be computed and reported without permanently materializing every predecessor row as verbose JSON; weighted one-dimensional squared loss retains the needed Monge structure.
included_sources.does_not_support: Paper-exact means globally optimal in its model, not A4's exact-rational bit semantics, binary32 collision rule, at-most-K rule, or custom recursive tie semantics.

included_sources.title: Designing Programs that Check Their Work
included_sources.reviewed_evidence: Definition of a program checker and independently checking a program's output on a given instance
included_sources.supports: Correctness checking can be designed as a distinct computation over an input and output rather than treating a producer trace as self-authenticating.
included_sources.does_not_support: Its generic checking results do not prove that an A4 partition, digest, or predecessor subset is a sufficient optimality certificate; A4-specific soundness or full independent replay remains required.

included_sources.title: Artifact Review and Badging - Current
included_sources.stable_id: ACM Artifact Review and Badging Version 1.1, 2020-08-24
included_sources.reviewed_evidence: Definitions of repeatability, reproducibility, replicability, functional artifacts, and independently reproduced results
included_sources.supports: Artifacts must be documented, consistent, complete for the paper's claim, exercisable, and independently auditable; result reproduction is a distinct activity from the original measured computation.
included_sources.does_not_support: It prescribes no A4 certificate schema, timer boundary, or numeric gate and does not permit omitting claim-relevant components.

included_sources.title: ACM SIGMOD Availability and Reproducibility Initiative
included_sources.reviewed_evidence: Artifact contents, independent reproduction, environment disclosure, and setup/run/cleanup experiment phases
included_sources.supports: A database-systems artifact should expose build environment, inputs, workload, measurement protocol, raw results, and programmable post-processing while documenting distinct setup, running, and cleanup phases.
included_sources.does_not_support: It does not require every internal DP state to be archived, and it does not say research-only packaging is algorithm runtime.

included_sources.title: SAQ Official Source Artifact
included_sources.reviewed_evidence: saqlib/quantization/saq_data.hpp, quantizer_data.hpp, cluster_data.hpp, cluster_packer.hpp, saqlib/index/ivf.hpp, caq/caq_encoder.hpp:172-245, caq/caq_estimator.hpp:56-60,190-216, fastscan/lut.hpp:121-125, and saq_estimator.hpp:28-47

evaluated_baseline.relationship: descendant of the official commit with positive one-bit packing and padded-lane finite-min correctness fixes

included_sources.supports: The official serialized IVF representation retains SAQ configuration and segment/rotation metadata, cluster short factors and MSB-fastscan/lower-bit CAQ codes, per-vector rescale/error factors and ids, and rotated centroids. The unchanged encoder/estimator consumes an implicit per-vector uniform scalar grid and rescale rather than learned per-group reconstruction codebooks.
included_sources.does_not_support: A4's learned two-coordinate product/block codebooks and mixed-radix labels are neither byte-for-byte index fields nor consumable by the unchanged current-SAQ estimator; the V2 bundle cannot be called retained, deployable, or current-SAQ-compatible.

included_sources.title: Secure Hash Standard (SHS), FIPS 180-4
authors: National Institute of Standards and Technology
included_sources.reviewed_evidence: SHA-256 message-digest definition and change-detection purpose
included_sources.supports: SHA-256 can bind a byte stream or logical-record encoding to a stable content identity and detect later byte changes.
included_sources.does_not_support: A matching digest does not prove that the computation was correct, that it ran, that the preimage is available, or that two producer/checker implementations are independent.

included_sources.title: SPEC CPU 2017 Run and Reporting Rules
included_sources.venue: Official SPEC CPU 2017 run and reporting rules
included_sources.stable_id: SPEC runrules.html revision 6644, 2021-09-13; living page accessed 2026-07-14
included_sources.reviewed_evidence: Conditions of observation, repeat runs, output validation, untimed test/train workloads, timed ref workload, and disclosure rules
included_sources.supports: Correctness validation may be required in the same reportable workflow while remaining outside the named timed workload; all performance-relevant conditions and excluded work must still be disclosed.
included_sources.does_not_support: SPEC's workloads, median rule, and thresholds are benchmark-specific and cannot be copied as A4 scientific constants.

included_sources.title: Principles for Automated and Reproducible Benchmarking
included_sources.reviewed_evidence: Code-Build-Run-FOM-Analysis workflow, fixed platform description, component runtime, validation, and programmable post-processing
included_sources.supports: A reproducible benchmark should name the performance figure of merit and keep code, build, run, result extraction, and analysis as explicit stages rather than merging all work into one ambiguous timer.
included_sources.does_not_support: It supplies no A4 correctness certificate, exact-arithmetic rule, projection factor, or resource ceiling.

included_sources.title: ANN-Benchmarks: A Benchmarking Tool for Approximate Nearest Neighbor Algorithms
included_sources.reviewed_evidence: Table 1 and Sections 2.2, 3.1, and 3.4 on index build time, index size, query time, quality, and framework overhead
included_sources.supports: ANN evaluation separates preprocessing/index construction, index bytes, query work, and quality; it also explicitly removes text-protocol parsing when that overhead would make query timing unrepresentative.
included_sources.does_not_support: It does not justify excluding production-required model or index materialization, and its Docker/framework choices are not A4 numeric semantics.

candidate_disposition.reason: Useful later synthesis of certificate/witness design, but Blum and Kannan is the primary program-checking source needed by this bounded review; V2 uses full independent replay rather than claiming a new compact certificate.
Useful time-to-quality precedent, but SPEC provides the clearer primary timed-versus-validation rule and ANN-Benchmarks is closer to the application domain.

candidate_disposition.candidate: Yap and Dube, The Exact Computation Paradigm; Shewchuk robust predicates; Neal exact summation
candidate_disposition.reason: Relevant to future exact-arithmetic implementation choices, but the authorized task does not change A4's exact rational objective or branch-authority semantics.

Useful environment-packaging system, but ACM/SIGMOD guidance already covers the bounded reproducibility requirement and the official SAQ source is necessary to prevent an unsupported retained-index claim.
